Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		obs: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(obs)
	postcondition:
		currentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(obs) and
		result = obs
}
